tasks.short: Choose locations and collect water samples.

steps.what: Print a sampling label when the location id exists.
Collect and preserve the water or wastewater samples.
Check the container and the preservation method.

tasks.design: A sampling label is printed from {DOCS} only when the location id is already on the plan. The inspector determines the location and the method, collects the water or wastewater, and preserves the sample in the right container. A plan with no location id does not choose the point. The label is not a sample.
tasks.previous_blocker: Labels were handwritten at the bank, and a preservation method from another analysis was used.
tasks.enabler_now: A planned location can carry a printed label.
tasks.still_hard: A location the plan does not name, and a sample that cannot be preserved as specified.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see that the planned point is not the water that should be sampled.
tasks.altitude: A planned point can have a label. The inspector still chooses the location, collects the sample, and checks the preservation. Nothing is analysed from a label alone.

reach.task: Label a planned point and still collect the sample there.
reach.learn: The label can be printed. The collection stays here.

evidence.claim: A label can be printed for a location id already on the plan. It cannot choose the point or collect the sample.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Location id and method id, produced by the sample plan. A plan with no location id is not given a label. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the sample plan the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which waters are sampled this week.
Who carries the samples to the laboratory.
research_questions: What share of points already have a location id?
Which samples are always collected by the inspector?

already_counted.description: The inspector still collects and preserves the samples.
The inspector still checks the container and the preservation.

incremental.description: The inspector adds a location the plan did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the printed label for a planned location. It disappears when the plan has no location id and the inspector writes the label. Collecting and preserving the sample stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep up with the regulations that apply.

steps.what: List developments that name a regulation on the watch list.
Research whether the development changes a procedure.
Decide that a procedure changes or that nothing changes.

tasks.design: Developments are listed from the official feed into {DOCS} only when they name a regulation already on the watch list. The inspector researches whether a listed item changes a procedure, including the decision that nothing changes. An item that names no listed regulation is not summarised. A note may cite only the rule in the file.
tasks.previous_blocker: The inspector heard about a rule change from a colleague and could not find the text.
tasks.enabler_now: Items that name a listed regulation can be gathered before the inspector reads them.
tasks.still_hard: A change that matters but does not name a listed regulation, and a text that does not change any procedure.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can tell that a matching title does not change the procedure this organisation uses.
tasks.altitude: Listed regulations are gathered. The inspector still decides whether a procedure changes, including that it does not. An unlisted title is not treated as a change.

reach.task: Filter a feed to named rules and still decide whether to act.
reach.learn: The filter can run. The decision stays here.

evidence.claim: A feed can be filtered to regulations already on a watch list. The filter cannot decide that a procedure changes.

A field compare does not register a product, approve a discharge, or change a procedure. The inspector decides, including that no action is taken. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Regulation id, produced by the watch list. An item that names no listed regulation id is not summarised. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the official sources the organisation already watches.
unknowns: Which regulations are on the watch list.
Who else must agree before a procedure changes.
research_questions: How many feed items name a listed regulation?
Which changes are always left as no action?

already_counted.description: The inspector still researches whether a procedure changes.
The inspector still records the decision, including no change.

incremental.description: The inspector reads an item the filter left out.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is filtering the feed to regulations already listed. It disappears when an item names no listed regulation and the inspector reads it anyway. Deciding whether a procedure changes stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend actions on hazardous waste problems.

steps.what: List stored spill figures for the hazardous waste problem.
Recommend corrective actions for the waste problem.
Review the draft waste rules before they are shared.

tasks.design: Stored spill figures are listed from {DOCS} for the hazardous waste problem. The inspector participates in the prevention program and recommends the corrective action. A recommendation may cite only a figure in that list. The figures do not write the rule, and the draft is not shared before the inspector reviews it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recommendations cited a volume that nobody could find in the spill record.
tasks.enabler_now: Figures already stored can be listed before the discussion.
tasks.still_hard: A problem with no stored figure, and a rule the figures do not justify.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a correct volume that points at the wrong corrective action.
tasks.altitude: The stored figures are in the discussion. The inspector still recommends the action and still reviews the draft rules. A figure that is not stored is not cited.

reach.task: Bring stored facts to a rule discussion and still write the recommendation.
reach.learn: The figures can be listed. The recommendation stays here.

evidence.claim: Stored spill figures can be listed. They cannot recommend the corrective action or write the waste rule.
A record is filed only when the required ids are already stored. A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a rule already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Spill id and figure id, produced by the spill record. A problem with no figure id is not given a list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the spill records the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which spills must be discussed with another authority.
research_questions: What share of problems have a stored figure?
Which recommendations are always made in a meeting?

already_counted.description: The inspector still recommends the corrective action.
The inspector still reviews the draft rules.

incremental.description: The inspector reconstructs a spill figure the record did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of spill figures already stored. It disappears when the figure is missing and the inspector reconstructs it. Recommending the action and reviewing the draft rules stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the facility permit and the local regulations.
Inspect waste treatment and disposal for conformance.
Record the conformance finding for that facility.

tasks.design: The facility permit and the local regulations are opened from {DOCS} before the visit. The inspector inspects waste pretreatment, treatment, and disposal for conformance. A facility with no permit id is not given a pack. The pack does not inspect the works.
tasks.previous_blocker: The inspector arrived with the wrong permit revision and wrote the finding that night.
tasks.enabler_now: The current permit can be the one opened.
tasks.still_hard: A works the permit does not describe, and a conformance question that needs another visit.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a plant that matches the permit drawing and still does not conform.
tasks.altitude: The current permit is open on the visit. The inspector still inspects the facility and still records the finding. The permit text is not the inspection.

reach.task: Open the current permit and still walk the facility.
reach.learn: The permit can be current. The inspection stays here.

evidence.claim: The current facility permit can be opened before a visit. It cannot inspect treatment or disposal.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Facility id and permit id, produced by the permit register. A facility with no permit id is not given a pack. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the permit register the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which facilities are due this month.
Which rules are federal, state, or local in this country.
research_questions: What share of facilities have a current permit id?
Which inspections are always done on site?

already_counted.description: The inspector still inspects the facility.
The inspector still records the conformance finding.

incremental.description: The inspector finds the permit the register did not open.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the current permit before the visit. It disappears when the facility has no permit id and the inspector searches for it. The inspection of the works stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector still takes the sample and still inspects the facility. A label, a named rule, and a stored spill figure can be ready before that work, and none of them is the finding.
reach: Regulatory affairs specialists keep a watch list of named rules, and this job learns a listed item is not a decision to change a procedure.
Government property inspectors collect a sample themselves, and this job learns a printed label is not the sample.
skills_to_grow: Stop a rule summary that does not name a rule on the watch list.
Keep sampling and the facility walk with the inspector.
role.ambitious_version: Named rules and stored spill figures are ready before the inspector writes, and the sample and the facility inspection are still done by that person.
